_: OpenCaseLaw law-code reference table. Derived from the statute mirror and Fedlex, plus the documented corrections in alias_notes; regenerate with scripts/build_law_code_table.py.
_why: The citation extractor emits language-specific law codes. A consumer that does not pair them (OR==CO, ZGB==CC) silently loses most French-language statute references.
_alias_to_sr: Code (upper-cased, as the extractor emits it) -> SR number of the act in force, or a list where several acts in force share it. Check alias_notes before trusting a lookup.
_alias_to_repealed: Code -> Fedlex ELI of every repealed act that bore it (rows in `repealed`, with in_force_from / in_force_until). A code in both indexes was borne by an earlier act too: resolve it by the decision date. Never map a repealed act by its SR number alone; the number is often reused by its successor.

usage_override.note: Upper-casing merges KLV (Krankenpflege-Leistungsverordnung, SR 832.112.31, since 1996) with KlV (Klimaschutzverordnung, SR 814.310.1, in force 2025-01-01). A decision before 2025-01-01 can only mean 832.112.31; after that date the code is ambiguous and 832.112.31 remains the established reading. 4,806 references, not found 0.3 % against 832.112.31, 30.5 % against 814.310.1.
